requirements.quote: provide a power switchover between the battery and charger to the Device.
requirements.text: The system must provide a power switchover between the battery and charger.

requirements.quote: The Device from OFF state, MUST switch ON when Button 1 is pressed.
requirements.text: Button 1 must turn the device on from an off state.

requirements.quote: To switch the Device OFF from ON state, when Button 1 is pressed and hold for about 3 seconds, the Device must switch OFF.
requirements.text: Button 1 must turn the device off when held for 3 seconds.

requirements.quote: When pressed, the bottom left block from the screen must be highlighted
requirements.text: Button 2 must highlight the bottom left block on the screen when pressed.

requirements.quote: When pressed, the bottom middle block from the screen must be highlighted
requirements.text: Button 3 must highlight the bottom middle block on the screen when pressed.

requirements.quote: When pressed, the bottom right block from the screen must be highlighted
requirements.text: Button 4 must highlight the bottom right block on the screen when pressed.

requirements.quote: When pressed, the bottom right block from the screen must be highlighted
requirements.text: Button 5 must highlight the bottom right block on the screen when pressed.

requirements.quote: Device IP address will be displayed on the screen
requirements.text: The device must display its IP address on the screen.
